name: Evening Melody
text: If you win three or more tricks with hearts in a round, gain +1× contract multiplier.

signature.trigger: scoring, three or more heart wins

archetypes: Heart Chorus; splash Kingmaker, Nil Guard
decision: Cashing hearts as winners rather than holding them, and growing them with Unfolding Butterfly and Verdant Banner so three of them win.
opponent: Opponents can trump hearts once void to keep the count below three.
aiNote: Lead your highest hearts once the opponents' high hearts are gone.
rationale: A Heart Chorus deck with five or six hearts and rank growth wins three heart tricks in about half its rounds, so the +1× is worth about +45 late, in the rare band, and it applies win or lose. Swelling Sea (TE-R03) counts the same rounds across the run; this pays within one.
deviation: Redesigned from making hearts trump from the seventh trick, which was complicated and punishing to play against.
